verdict.rationale: QuickBooks docs mention auto-sorting expenses (quickbooks-docs-28) and community evidence confirms built-in automatic categorization rules (quickbooks-comm-3), but neither source explicitly describes a machine-learning mechanism that adapts based on the founder's manual corrections. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of ML-based re-categorization suggestions, first-party confirmation that the system improves from user corrections, and independent hands-on validation of this adaptive behavior.
